_about: D08.6/D08.5: the sign-in card's one-liner for a raw failure (errcode + message + status on the web, the error chain on the desktop). Byte-identical in the desktop (crates/app/src/testvectors/login-errors.json, login_errors.rs) and Tin Hat Web (src/core/matrix/testvectors/login-errors.json, errors.ts). Rules in order; the raw text goes to the log, never to the card.

cases.name: desktop wrong password
cases.raw: the server returned an error: [403 / M_FORBIDDEN] Invalid username or password
cases.want: Wrong username or password.

cases.name: web wrong password
cases.raw: M_FORBIDDEN Invalid username or password 403
cases.want: Wrong username or password.

cases.name: web rate limit
cases.raw: M_LIMIT_EXCEEDED Too Many Requests 429
cases.want: Too many attempts — wait a minute and try again.

cases.name: desktop rate limit
cases.raw: the server returned an error: [429 / M_LIMIT_EXCEEDED] Too Many Requests
cases.want: Too many attempts — wait a minute and try again.

cases.name: deactivated
cases.raw: M_USER_DEACTIVATED This account has been deactivated 403
cases.want: That account has been deactivated.

cases.name: locked
cases.raw: M_USER_LOCKED This account has been locked 401
cases.want: That account is locked — ask whoever runs the server.

cases.name: suspended
cases.raw: M_USER_SUSPENDED This account has been suspended 403
cases.want: That account is suspended — ask whoever runs the server.

cases.name: unknown issuer before the connect words
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org/_matrix/client/v3/login): client error (Connect): invalid peer certificate: UnknownIssuer
cases.want: The server's certificate isn't trusted on this machine.

cases.name: expired certificate names the clock
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org/): client error (Connect): invalid peer certificate: Expired
cases.want: The server's certificate looks out of date — check that this device's date and time are right.

cases.name: not-yet-valid certificate names the clock
cases.raw: client error (Connect): invalid peer certificate: NotValidYet
cases.want: The server's certificate looks out of date — check that this device's date and time are right.

cases.name: dns
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://nosuch.example/): client error (Connect): dns error: failed to lookup address information: Name or service not known
cases.want: Can't find that server — check the address.

cases.name: web dns
cases.raw: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED
cases.want: Can't find that server — check the address.

cases.name: web offline
cases.raw: Failed to fetch
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: connection refused
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org/): client error (Connect): tcp connect error: Connection refused (os error 111)
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: timed out
cases.raw: operation timed out
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: proxy 502 page
cases.raw: M_UNKNOWN <html><head><title>502 Bad Gateway</title></head></html> 502
cases.want: The server is having trouble right now — try again in a few minutes.

cases.name: gateway timeout is the server, not the connection
cases.raw: the server returned an error: [504] Gateway Timeout
cases.want: The server is having trouble right now — try again in a few minutes.

cases.name: desktop 503 with no words
cases.raw: the server returned an error: [503 / M_UNKNOWN]
cases.want: The server is having trouble right now — try again in a few minutes.

cases.name: web 500
cases.raw: M_UNKNOWN Internal server error 500
cases.want: The server is having trouble right now — try again in a few minutes.

cases.name: port numbers are not status codes
cases.raw: the server returned an error: [404 / M_UNRECOGNIZED] Unrecognized request at https://chat.example.org:5003/
cases.want: That doesn't look like a Matrix server.

cases.name: a port is not a rate limit
cases.raw: M_UNRECOGNIZED Unrecognized request at https://chat.example.org:4290/ 404
cases.want: That doesn't look like a Matrix server.

cases.name: a TLS negotiation failure is not an untrusted certificate
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org/): client error (Connect): received fatal alert: HandshakeFailure
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: a port in an address is not a status
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org:503/_matrix/client/v3/login): operation timed out
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: a 503 port with no other words is still no status
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org:503/)
cases.want: Sign-in didn't work — try again in a moment.

cases.name: a socket address's port is not a status
cases.raw: tcp connect error: 127.0.0.1:429: Connection refused (os error 111)
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: a client certificate request is not an untrusted server
cases.raw: error sending request for url (https://chat.example.org/): client error (Connect): received fatal alert: CertificateRequired
cases.want: Can't reach the server — check your connection and the address.

cases.name: well-known
cases.raw: the .well-known file is invalid
cases.want: That doesn't look like a Matrix server.

cases.name: a proxy's bare 403 page is not a wrong password
cases.raw: <html><title>403 Forbidden</title></html> 403
cases.want: The server refused to sign you in — check the address, or ask whoever runs it.

cases.name: unknown server text never shows raw
cases.raw: M_UNKNOWN Something odd happened in module x::y 400
cases.want: Sign-in didn't work — try again in a moment.

cases.name: empty
cases.want: Sign-in didn't work — try again in a moment.

unreachable.want: Couldn't reach chat.example.org — check your connection and the address.
Couldn't reach the server — check your connection and the address.
